title: Add deterministic evidence reduction for probabilistic swarm proposals

before.state: Virtual Memory could route and unfold bounded ContextPackets, but probabilistic model/swarm interpretations had no Origami-owned canonical reducer. Agreement could not be distinguished from repeated unsupported guesses by a deterministic contract.

after.state: External swarms emit structured SUPPORT/OPPOSE/UNKNOWN proposals tied to Origami evidence addresses. Origami resolves address/CID/source-hash/fidelity identity, rejects unverified or mismatched evidence, deduplicates repeated evidence, preserves verified conflicts, returns UNKNOWN when support is insufficient, and emits order-deterministic canonical claim IDs and a reduction digest.

boundary.tlaloc: swarm search, agent prompts, exploration and proposal generation
boundary.origami: addressable evidence authority, identity checks, deterministic reduction and exactness state
